title: Synthesis of a highly stable Mo–Fe bimetallic metal–organic framework and its catalytic activity for the selective oxidation of sulfides under mild conditions
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38002-38008
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06324D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xin Li, Mohan Zu, Linzhuo Yan, Qiang Zhao, Liu Liu
A novel Mo–Fe bimetallic metal–organic framework [Fe2(4,4′-bipy)Mo2O8]·2H2O (1) has been synthesized, and its selective catalytic oxidation of thioether has been investigated.
